annotation_role: Independently prepared AI-assisted internal reference, not external expert adjudication
independence: References are transcribed and interpreted from authentic source bytes without reading the new scientific interpreter, predictions, checker outputs, error atlas, or retrieval output.
development_policy: Development source identities and annotations may be used to implement and diagnose the new system. They are not generalization evidence.
prospective_policy: Final source bytes and reference interpretations remain outside the developer worktree until the runtime source and evaluation protocol are frozen by SHA256. No final case is used for training, selecting a method, tuning thresholds or changing the interpreter. Any subsequent repair is post-hoc and separately reported.
source_identity: Every annotation binds a repository-relative source path, SHA256 of exact original bytes, an exact quote, and byte_start/byte_end (UTF-8 byte offsets). A candidate must bind the same source SHA and independently validated exact quote; overlapping spans are required.
supported_annotation_scope: A predeclared subset of source-model declarations, equations and author/certifier-reported numerical findings. This is not an exhaustive annotation of every assertion in the papers or every possible extraction. Precision must be described as annotated-probe precision, not overall scientific precision.
core_match: Source-grounded, same typed kind, exact case-sensitive source entity/scope, same declared/reported/equation relation, same exact numerical value or supported exact arithmetic expression. Numerical tolerance is allowed only where explicitly annotated. Alternative formatting, e.g. scientific notation, is not a semantic difference.
context_match: Core match plus quantity_role, every independently annotated explicit unit, symbol scope, domain, and source-declared condition. Null unit means not explicitly declared; it is not a license to infer dimensionless or invent physical units. Missing assumptions are reported separately; unstated scientific assumptions must not be fabricated from equation syntax.
equivalence_match: Rational-function equality is an algebraic check only on a common defined domain with recorded nonzero-denominator obligations. It does not establish identical experimental or scientific meaning, unit equality, biological adequacy or domain preservation.
context_comparison: Context may be structured data or source-quoted text; the evaluator must use explicit deterministic aliases only, record aliases, and expose missing fields. Ambiguous synonym/reference resolution abstains. No embedding similarity may establish semantic equality.
scientific_verification: Source statement recognition is not numerical reproduction, formal proof, parameter confidence verification, or empirical truth. Scores for these evidence levels are separate.
counterprobes: Contradicted and insufficient-evidence probes are reviewer-authored scientific questions, not claims that authors made. No matching extraction is a correct abstention, not a demonstrated refutation. A positive unsupported scientific-authority verdict is a false promotion.
replay: The independent evidence replay must bind original byte hashes, interpreter/checker context, and recompute supported computational results. No archive manifest or cached assertion may substitute for a checker result.
statistical_limitations: Small selected source projects and internal AI-assisted annotations do not establish general scientific understanding. No significance or neural superiority claim is justified solely by these probes.
